test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana account can be opened by the parents of a girl child or legal guardians, any time before the girl child attains ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) **account can be opened by the **parents or legal guardians of a girl child **any time before the** girl child attains the age of 10 years.**
 
• This scheme, which is part of the** "Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao"** initiative by the **Government of India**, is intended to ensure a secure financial future for **girls in India**.
 
• The account reaches maturity after** 21 years** from the date of opening the account, or it can be closed after the girl gets married after** turning 18**.
 
• Partial withdrawal for education purposes is also allowed after the girl has turned 18. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **interest rate** on the **Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana** is fixed by the government and reviewed every quarter.
 
• The Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana interest rate for **2023** is **8%**.
